## Goal

B20, B21: a non-holder's mailbox receipt is stamped from the last boundary (local) or the record ref (remote) and says the holder checks it; a receipt the holder rejects shows as a Check item that clears on its own. Restore the skipped `mailbox (T9)` block in packages/cli/test/integration/human.test.ts.
